# Find out more about WA's defence capability

Western Australian industries have the capacity and expertise to deliver across the six capability streams identified by Defence.

Last updated: 12 June 2025

Defence West has undertaken a Defence Capability Assessment to gauge the State’s industrial, research and development, and education and training capabilities.

The results of this assessment were used to create the inaugural Western Australian Directory of Defence Industry Capabilities. This was an initial assessment which provides a baseline on which to build industry capabilities to deliver the needs of Defence.

Access the WA Defence Industry Capability Directory
